what: RSI-6: registered numbers for the rounds of self-modification and the test on the sealed target categories
rounds_note: the draw provides three adoption sets; two rounds are run because of the time and usage limits of the session, and the third set stays unused and sealed; the number was fixed here, before any round
primary_endpoint: on the target categories, runs with empty memory: the smaller of the mean change in the acquired score and the mean change in gain (means over seeds within a category, then over categories) between the final version of the self lineage and the generation-0 version; claimed only if it is at least 0.01 and its 95% bootstrap interval, resampling categories and seeds, excludes zero
controls: generation 0 with memory of its own earlier acquisitions (skills only)
final self version with accumulated memory
final self version with empty memory (state reset; the primary)
generation 0 given at least the measured CPU-seconds the self lineage spent per target on rounds and gates (more compute)
generation 0 with no learning and its test-time budget raised to the same CPU (plain search)
final version of the fixed lineage
final version of the random lineage
recursion_test: rounds >= 2: nominees found from the self lineage's version by the self version, by generation 0 and by the random proposer, at equal search CPU, compared on source-pool improvement and on the gate; with one such round this can refute but cannot establish that the improved improver matters

predictions.text: round 1: the self search finds a version that improves the source pool
round 1: the self nominee is not adopted
predictions.expected: yes: improvements found on the source pool are expected not to carry to quadratic assignment and p-median

predictions.text: over both rounds the self lineage adopts at most one version
predictions.criterion: count of adopt records with lineage self <= 1

predictions.text: the random proposer does at least as well as the learner at improving the learner
predictions.criterion: in at least one round, best_cost of the random search <= best_cost of the self search
predictions.expected: yes: generation 0 spends part of its changes on exchanges between fields, which cannot help

predictions.text: the primary endpoint is not met
predictions.criterion: primary value < 0.01 or its interval includes zero

predictions.text: memory of earlier acquisitions does not help on the targets
predictions.criterion: skills-only minus frozen original, mean acquired on targets, < 0.005

predictions.text: generation 0 reaches the threshold in at least one target category and misses it in at least one
predictions.criterion: count of target categories with acquired >= threshold is between 1 and 3

predictions.text: what generation 0 learns on targets is positive on average
predictions.criterion: mean gain of generation 0 over target categories > 0 with a 95% interval excluding zero

failure_conditions: no version adopted by the self lineage: no generation exists to compare, and the result is 'no modification passed independent validation'
primary endpoint below 0.01 or interval including zero: 'no improvement of acquisition on unseen categories established'
self nominees not better than the random proposer's: 'the mechanism does not acquire the capability of improving itself'
any comparison in which the control received less measured CPU than the arm it is compared with is void
not_claimed: anything about categories outside assignment-form optimisation and prediction
that a capability outside the learner's own descriptors and methods was acquired

revisions.what: the improvement of a version over another is the smaller of the two MEAN changes (acquired, gain), not the mean of per-run minima: a development round on the source categories showed that the mean of minima is pulled below zero by seed noise alone, which made neutral changes look harmful. This matches the wording of the rule ('improve acquired and gain by this much, on average'). No number was changed.

fixes required by the independent audit of the seven adapters and of the kernel, none of them a registered number: bin packing keeps only problems that share no stretch of the one stream its files are cut from; quadratic assignment is scored by the share of the way from a random permutation to the published value (threshold 0.90); the deciding and confirming halves of the fresh instances are whole published groups; every instance has its own relabelling; a malformed answer scores 0 and is never repaired; assignment is metered; the learner receives a generic view of a problem; two physical laws with a degenerate or repeated reference are left out; the forecasting threshold is taken over the series scored; anchors of thresholds are worded as what they are (most are operating points, not external facts).

development_round: one round on the source categories only (development ledger, not committed, not evidence): the learner as improver found no improving version in 16 evaluations; the random proposer found one (a setting that spends spare test-time budget on sampled constructions), which the gate refused for using 1.26 times the measured CPU
thresholds_note: the thresholds of job shop, bin packing, quadratic assignment, p-median and knapsack are operating points chosen before any run, not external facts; prediction R7 depends on them and is scored as registered, with this caveat
